caption:
Told you have a rotator cuff tear and wondering what now?

After 50, some rotator cuff tearing is common, even in people with no pain. For many age-related tears, current guidelines suggest starting with a structured exercise program, and many people see meaningful improvement in pain and everyday function.

A typical plan starts gently, then builds strength through the cuff, shoulder blade and upper back two to three times a week. Give it a fair trial of around three months and track real tasks like reaching overhead. A sudden loss of strength after a fall, or being unable to lift your arm, is worth a prompt check.

Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can walk you through it. Book online via the link in bio. 💪
